name: Subagents
summary: A main agent hands self-contained subtasks to subagents, each running in its own fresh context window, often in parallel. Each subagent returns only a short result, so the main context stays clean. Claude Code subagents and Anthropic's research system use this orchestrator-worker shape.
facts: Claude Code, Anthropic Research, LangChain subagents
Keeps the main context small; parallel work
~15x a chat interaction in Anthropic's research system (vendor-reported)
Subagents miss context the main agent did not pass on
how: Main agent splits off a self-contained subtask
Spawn a subagent with its own prompt, tools and empty context
Run several subagents in parallel when the subtasks are independent
Each subagent returns a condensed result
Main agent merges the results and continues
watchOut: Subagents making conflicting decisions on coupled work
Results are only as good as the handoff prompt
